headline: Binance Seeks to Recover $6.3 Billion Stolen in North Korea-Linked Hack
summary: Crypto exchange Binance is attempting to recover $6.3 billion stolen in a complex cyber-attack linked to North Korea, believed to be the largest hack of its kind.
why: Binance is one of the world's largest cryptocurrency exchanges, and major security breaches or recovery efforts can impact digital asset markets and regulatory scrutiny on crypto platforms.
why_moved: A multi-billion-dollar theft at a major crypto exchange raises concerns over digital asset security and potential liquidations.
